predeclaration_note: All four variants and the selection rule were fixed before any 2024 metric was computed. Descriptive legs (published PUT index, BXM index, cash, market proxy) are anchors, not trials.

trials.definition: 100% Cboe PUT methodology index returns, zero implementation drag.
trials.why_not_selectable: PUT is a methodology index whose option legs are theoretical/index assumptions with untradeable pricing and embedded collateral assumptions; presenting its returns as executable PnL is exactly the non-goal the task forbids.

trials.definition: 100% PUT methodology-index return minus full predeclared implementation-drag stack (tracking 15bps, collateral shortfall 25bps, admin/tax 20bps annual, deploy/turnover 30bps per 100% turnover, initial deployment turnover 100%).

parameters.signal_timing: static allocation; next-bar daily; no timing signal

trials.cost_model_application: daily drag = (15+25+20)bps/252 scaled by option share; turnover cost = 30bps * daily |dw|; both doubled in the 2x stress rerun.

trials.definition: 100% PUT when prior month-end VIX close > trailing 126-trading-day VIX median, else 100% market proxy; full drag stack; monthly rebalance turnover.

parameters.rebalance: monthly at month-end signal, next-month application

trials.definition: fixed 50/50 PUT / market proxy with full drag stack.

selection.rule: highest development-window net Sharpe among T2/T3/T4; T1 excluded as non-tradable anchor
selection.frozen_before_validation: selection.json written before the single 2024 read; run.py refuses to continue if a rerun would change the selection

falsification_logic.T2_vs_market: Investability drag plus 2024's exceptional bull market puts the executable put-write book behind the market proxy in BOTH windows: development excess -1.9%/yr (HAC t=-0.49, indistinguishable from zero), validation excess -8.4%/yr (HAC t=-1.00), 2x-stress validation excess -9.1%/yr. The named benchmark for this family is the SPX-direction market proxy; the validation-pass contract requires positive benchmark-relative excess, which fails.
falsification_logic.T2_vs_cash: The volatility premium itself is real in both windows (dev +8.7%/yr, val +12.3%/yr over cash): the drag-adjusted put-write book meaningfully beats cash. This is the honest positive statement the data supports.
falsification_logic.conclusion: The index-level volatility premium exists as a cash-relative risk premium, but after conservative implementation drags it is a market-underperforming, beta-laden cash-plus alternative - not market-relative alpha.

T3_lagged_vs_lookahead_dev_sharpe.interpretation: look-ahead variant materially better, proving the production signal uses only prior-month information

leakage_probes.signal_timing: VIX regime at month-end m; applied to days m+1..m+2 onward through month m+1; index/rf returns are contemporaneous daily
leakage_probes.embargo: all computation censored at 2024-12-31; outputs contain no post-2024 observation

known_searches_informing_family: Cboe published PUT/BXM long-history marketing comparisons (public, prior knowledge)
no local prior volatility-premium backtest artifacts in the workspace inventory
